'''Paweł Urban''' (also spelled as Pawel L. Urban (Chinese name: 鄂本帕偉)) is a chemist and is a professor of Chemistry in the [[National Tsing Hua University]] ([[Hsinchu]], [[Taiwan]]). He received his Ph.D. in Chemistry from the [[University of York]] ([[United Kingdom]]).<ref>{{cite journal|title="Introducing Our Authors" entry from ACS Synthetic Biology journal (2016) | doi=10.1021/acssynbio.6b00238 | volume=5| issue=9 |journal=ACS Synthetic Biology|pages=915–919|year = 2016|last1 = Prithviraj|first1 = Ranjini}}</ref> Urban's research interests include [[mass spectrometry]] and [[biochemical analysis]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.urbanlab.tw|title=Urban Lab website}}</ref>

==Academic activity==
Urban is an inventor of the hydrogel micropatch sampling method, fizzy extraction, systems for imaging chemical reactions, and [[micro-arrays for mass spectrometry]] (MAMS). He co-authored a book on [[time-resolved mass spectrometry]], and over 100 papers. Urban is associate editor of ''[[HardwareX]]'' and acted as a guest editor in ''[[Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society A]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://rsta.royalsocietypublishing.org/content/374/2079?current-issue=y|title=Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society A - theme issue on Quantitative Mass Spectrometry}}</ref> His h-index is 34.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=FvKNnLYAAAAJ&hl=en|title=Google Scholar - Pawel L. Urban}}</ref> He received the Ta-You Wu Memorial Award.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://20210223256800.xlog.com.tw/motion.asp?siteid=1007458&menuid=49029&postid=696153|title=MOST - Ta-You Wu Memorial Award}}</ref>
